---
title: "Altmetric links"
output: html_document
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B, %Y')`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE, comment='', dpi=400)

# get the data, from 5_get_altmetric.R
load('data/5_altmetric.RData')
N = nrow(altmetric)
```

Makes a list of _Altmetric_ links so that we can check what Tweets, etc the authors wrote.

```{r make_urls, results='asis' }
for (k in 1:N){
  if(!is.na(altmetric$altmetric_id[k])){ # only if not missing
  cat('https://www.altmetric.com/details/', altmetric$altmetric_id[k], '\n', sep='')
  }
}
```
